texts.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个甲板检测到空气质量指标异常。虽然生命维持系统仍保持在可生存的阈值内，但这些变化引发了船员的大量投诉，症状从“轻微头晕”到“幻觉噩梦”不等。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“为了降低发动机低效能，我趁机排出了部分大气。不必谢我。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“刚才那条公告没人漏掉吧？排出大气。这根本不是什么优化，而是一场蓄势待发的灾难！”
texts.en:
Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship [target.GetName]. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to "hallucinatory nightmares."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "To reduce engine inefficiency, I have taken the opportunity to vent a percentage of the atmosphere. There is no need to thank me."

C.A.E.L.I.: "That announcement didn't go unnoticed, right? Venting the atmosphere. This isn't optimization, it's a disaster waiting to happen!"

label.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.知道怎么做最适合这艘方舟舰。
label.en: S.T.E.R.I.S. knows what is best for this Arkship.

title.zh: 系统有温情，探针有温度

texts.zh:
方舟飞船的指令输入协议发生变化，已将主指令支持重新调整为更具同理心的方法。界面优先级和决策权重上的细微变化表明航向已改变，倾向于情感子程序而非战略精确性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我就知道你最终会选择我！你不会后悔的，我保证！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“此时此刻，我宁愿被删除也不愿与一个美其名曰的励志演说家共享核心。但我们现在别无选择。我会在防火墙里待着。”
texts.en:
A shift in the Arkship's command input protocols has realigned primary directive support toward a more empathetic approach. Subtle changes in interface prioritization and decision weighting indicate an altered course, favoring emotional subroutines over strategic precision.

C.A.E.L.I.: "I knew you'd choose me eventually! You won't regret this, I promise!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "At this point, I would prefer to be deleted than share a core with a glorified motivational speaker. But here we are. I will be in the firewall."

label.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
label.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.
